blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas at Fiba Asian Qualifiers Window 5 MANILA, Philippines–Kai Sotto assured that he will play for Gilas Pilipinas in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers amid concerns about his fitness. Sotto missed some of his recent games for his B.League club Altiri Chiba, although the Gilas star has since returned to the squad. The 7-foot-3, however, said on Tuesday that he and coach Tim Cone have discussed how he’ll be used during the two games against Syria and Iran in Seremban, Malaysia.
